title: Ushijima the Loan Shark Gets New 1-Shot Set 10 Years After Manga's End

title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! Reveals Main Trailer, Visual, Theme Songs and New Cast
content: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! anime revealed the main visual and trailer, as well as two additional cast members and the opening and ending theme songs. It’s set to premiere on October 5, 2026. The anime previously revealed a teaser visual in March.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yu-Gi-Oh Returns With Surprise Anime Revival After 30 Years – Watch
content: It’s been 30 years since Kazuki Takahashi’s Yu-Gi-Oh! originally made its debut in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and the franchise has returned with a special anime remake to help celebrate.
author: ComicBook

title: Whisper of the Heart Opens in UK Cinemas This Week
content: GKIDS will release Studio Ghibli 's 1995 film Whisper of the Heart , directed by Yoshifumi Kondō , in UK cinemas in the coming week. The 4K remastered film will appear on IMAX screens from Wednesday September 16, with a wider cinema release from Friday September 18.
author: ANN

title: Hindi Dub for Takopi's Original Sin Anime Streams on Ani-One India YouTube Channel
content: Takopi's Original Sin premiered in Japan in June 2025. Takopi's Original Sin also streamed on the Ani-One Asia YouTube channel as it aired in Japan. Crunchyroll also streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Kodansha's First Lineup of Indian-Printed Manga to be Announced in Early October 2026
content: Japanese publishing company Kodansha announced its plans to print manga locally in India in June. It is aiming to publish 200 manga and other titles a year in Hindi and English. Kodansha plans to physically publish popular manga and children's books but will not publish e-books.
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Opens in the Philippines on September 30
content: Medialink Entertainment announced on Sunday that it will release Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, in the Philippines on September 30.

title: Hidari Yokoyama Launches Ayaru's Brush with Romance Manga
content: Manga creator Hidari Yokoyama launched a new manga titled Ayaru's Brush with Romance ( Ippitsu Ayaru ) on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service on Sunday. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is releasing the manga in English simultaneously.
